deviations.reason: root-files/.gitignore deploys only into a consumer's .claude/ directory (per orchestrator-runtime-files.md's own 'Consumer Repo Setup' section), so a specs/-rooted pattern placed there would resolve to .claude/specs/... and match nothing real. Verified by grepping every existing sibling ephemeral-file (.orchestrator-churn-state.json, .events.lock) registration site in agent-system/extensions/core/: none of them appear in root-files/.gitignore either. The correct targets are this repo's own top-level .gitignore (already carries the sibling pattern block) and the documented 'Consumer Repo Setup' gitignore block in orchestrator-runtime-files.md that consumer repos copy by hand.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — root-files/.gitignore is the wrong target; edited this repo's own root .gitignore and the documented Consumer Repo Setup block instead)*
